description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommand' for command-line interface operations within the Goteo project, including logging, input/output handling, and event dispatching.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract class extending Symfony's Command, providing logging, input/output management, and event dispatching functionalities for CLI commands.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input interface for the command.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output interface for the command.

methods.name: addLogger
methods.description: Adds a logger instance to the command's logger collection.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a logger instance by name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with context, outputting to console if available, and calling the logger.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event via the Console class.
